# Board reference photograph

`web/nexys-a7-photo.jpg` is the Digilent Nexys A7 product photograph, used to implement the user's requested photographic board reference. The manufacturer owns its photograph and trademarks; it is not original project artwork and is not represented as MIT/open-licensed.

Accessible image source: https://github.com/ADolbyB/vhdl-fpga-nexys-a7/blob/main/Assets/NexysA7.jpg

That repository's README credits the original [Digilent product page](https://digilent.com/shop/nexys-a7-fpga-trainer-board-recommended-for-ece-curriculum/). The source photograph is included without altering its pixels, at 1280 × 1193. Relative to the user's 600 × 550 reference it has slightly different outer margins. HTML overlays supply the animated controls and display. Inclusion does not imply endorsement by Digilent or AMD/Xilinx.
